book.name: Ion
book.title: Ion Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Ion girumalena

content: Iesu apana 5000 nana wanamode
Iesu Ierusalemwa gagaloleidie diasane ene alene doa Galili tampe wisene waa asiasi nawenpue waiwa dawo alen. Doa Galili ebowa da waia Taiberias.
Apana uaraia Iesu me ginasawa kerolala mampo dewasano eweiena baiwa me warorosane antoiena.
Tane Iesu menasana me wawe alala do muba nambe wampe bubuantopono nuau topona, sa baiwa mo wadiwa odane antone waimoie.
Tane walama sawo Iuswa odau Pasowa napua walamawa kampaleidie.
Iesu wawe alala do sape waimoie me pisiwane apana uaraia me mampe ieio ewamone Pilip diene wanase, “No naepe bured gimarantate apana ema wanamoto napu?”
Iesu aia ema wana, sa ipa Pilip sumanaiwa rubusapie ewepia baiwa, tane me meba nuawe insene atenlen me ando dima dewasapi.
Pilip sipoasane wanase, “Tatamba, ambi epe dewasato segalepi. Ena dea nolawa malesawa mai rua bured gimarantate apana uaraia ema nana kampa kerakera wanamoto napu!”

Wawe alala da Saimon Pita wamba Endru mo epe gagalontoio etamone Iesu diene wanase, “Oto mape enedia mampe bured uduudu 5 ita bouri kerakera nata winei, tane sa apana uara mai napuo pokamopia rua, dia!”

Tane Iesu wawe alala mampo wane wanase, “Apana diamono nana baiwa aisintopue wampu.” Mo Iesu wana rua apana diamoieno sape bola euda ina osowe uduudu aisintone waimoiena. Sape apana mona os wisiawa 5000 rua waden.
Tauma Iesu bured otamone God auwasano dialeno apana sa uara menamodia rua wanamon. Tane deawaa bouri wadene God auwasane mampo amonaleno nane pokamon.
Apana uduudu nana nane pokamono Iesu wawe alala diamone wanase, “Nana moawa winakasalena auwena, mai da eno kadilepi, dia.”
Ita mo uduudu bured 5 Iesu dewasano uaraleno apana naie eiena moawa auwene posawa 12 aimoieno nopemoiena.
Apana sape wimoiena Iesu ginasawa ema dewasano ewane waienase, “Ulaipa, me ipa peroweta tawo osowe wisepona umanawa waia tauma wisen.”
Mo epe waio Iesu atenlen apana me ginasawa eweiena baiwa mo insaisau rua wareresapua baiwantoi. Sa baiwa me osowe apana emone meba os wadi sa osowe bola dainalawo odene alene wandie.
Iesu wawe alala mampo esa osowainta aleidie
Rawileidio Iesu wawe alala os wadiwae iane anton esa tampe.
Sape mo waa bedewe odane nawane Kapeanaumwa antoio tadinalen, tane Iesu mai tauwadea mo mampo wisepona, dia.
Mo muba nawane antoio lawara badowa wiseno esa tepaidaleidio a babiidasaie.
Wawe alala wolentone doa Galili sawanawentoio Iesu esa osowainta enene iedie waa mampeleidio mo ewane saidantone uwauwanton.
Tane Iesu mo saidantoio ewamone diamone wanase, “Mai saitana, ne iedina!”
Tauma mo nuau badoleno menaidamodia Iesu waa bedewe odepe wampona. Ita me odene waino waa tauwadea doa waiwa naepe antoiawo nomoiena.

Imonemba apana uaraia doa waiwa dawo emoiena insene atenton Iesu wawe alala do waa dea asiasi wimon ita waa sa deawaa osowe nawane leuntone anton. Tane Iesu mai me wawe alala do antopona. Sa baiwa mo insakoantone inseienase, “Iesu naepe alen?”
Waa isiwa bola Taiberias ene doa waiwa dawo naepe bauta Tatamba Iesu bured wadene auwalene apana wanamono naienawo wimone eneie.
Apana waiwa sawo wankasantona Iesu banusanalewantone tauma atentoiena Iesu ita wawe alala do mai sape, dia. Sa baiwa mo waa sape eneia bedeuwo odane nawane Kapeanaumwa antone Iesu banusaie.
Iesu me ipa buredida apana inaida wanamode
Apana doa waiwa dawo Iesu donsane diane waienase, “Debamamba, walama dainea e mape wien?”
Iesu sipoamone wanase, “Ne ulaipa dialedina, e ne banuneilana, ipawa e bured nale pokalen, mai ginasa ewape ipawaida ateitape baiwa ne banuneipona, dia!

Mai nana kadilepie dialepia baiwa insenune nolawaitonuna, dia. Tane nanaida winakasalala Apana Otopa e enalepia insenune nolawaitonuna! Ita nana ipa sa mampe e inawinakasala wadana. Ne epe wadina, ipawa Apana Otopa Mamamba mampe muka waden nanaida winakasalala apana wanamopia baiwa.”
Apana sape eneia Iesu epe wano etane insakoantone me waitarasane waienase, “No ambi dewantate God nolawa ruawantate dewasata?”
Iesu sipoamone wanase, “God nolawaida e dewasana menasadia ipa ema epe: E sumanaitana mida me wanaubena mampe!”
Tane mo Iesu waitarasane waienase, “E ginasa da dewasawo no ewate sumanaiantata! E dewa inainamba dainea dewasawo no atentata God e waaubaeno wien?
E nana winakasalala apana wanamoa umanawa waana. Tane no nosinosimba sala makowa bedewe nana ebowa waia Manna naiena. Ita buka bedewe girumalena wadi wadiase, ‘Me bured uboa wanamon napua baiwa.’”
Iesu mo sipoamone wanase, “Ne ulaipa dialedina, Moses mai bured uboa e nosinosila wanamopona, dia. Tane tauma ne Mamana buredida uboa enalede.
Ne epe dialedina, ipawa buredida God mampea ipa me mida uboe iene wisene ita tawo inaida wanedia.”
Iesu buredida umanawa wano mo etane me diane waienase, “Tatamba, bured ema walama uduudu nenono nanta!”
Tauma Iesu wasabamosane wanase, “Ne ipa buredida apana inawinakasala wanamodina. Mida ne mainawo iedia mai omanatopi, diaida, ita mida ne mainawo sumanaileidia mai nuawa makolepi, dia.
Tane ne bauta dialena rua tauma segaleide, e ne ewanele tane mai sumanaitipona, dia.
Mai apana da meba insaisawa rua sumanailepie mainawo wimpia rua, dia! Tane apana mida Mamana sonabedie ne nedia me ipa mainawo wimpi. Ita mida ne mainawo wisena ne mai tanapo nosepie alepi, diaida.
Ne epe dewanteapa, ipawa ne uboe iane winena mai ne neba insaisana dewasapaa baiwa, dia. Tane mida ne waaubanena insaisawa dewasapaa baiwa winen.
Ita ne Mamana waaubanena insaisawa ipa ema epe: Apana mida Mamana ne nedia mai da ewapakadisapo rebalepi, dia. Tane walama ompa osowe inasapo bo bedewe enepiwisepi.
Ita do ne Mamana waaubanena insaisawa ema epe: Apana mida me Otopa ewedie me bedewe sumanaileidia inawinakasala wadedie mampesade. Ita ne walama ompa osowe me inasapo bo bedewe enepiwisepi.”
Ius apanawa gagalo ema etane momoduntoiena, ipawa Iesu wane wanase, “Ne ipa buredida uboe iane winen.”
Mo waienase, “Apana ema ipa Iesu, Iosep otopa. Me mamba ita inawa no ateinimba, tane ambi tauma me wadiase, ‘Ne uboe iane winen?’”
Iesu mo momoduntoio etamone diamone wanase, “Mai eba momoduitonuna, eidasana!
Ne epe dialedina, ipawa mai mida da meba mukawe ne mainawo wimpia rua, dia! Tane dea os, mida Mamamba nuawa teinepio ne mainawo wimpi, ita walama ompa osowe me inasapo bo bedewe enepiwisepi.
Peroweta bukau bedewe girumalena epe wadi wadiase, ‘God meba mo uduudu waeuwamopio me insaisawa atentopu.’ Sa baiwa mida Mamamba aiawa asisusadie ita me mampe aten wadedia, me ne mainawo wimpi.
Mai mida Mamamba ewapona, diaida! Dea os, mida Mamamba mampea me Mamamba ewen ita me inainamba sabamosade.
Ne ulaipa dialedina, mida sumanaileidia me inawinakasala wadedie mampesade.
Ne ipa buredida apana inawinakasala wanamodina.
E nosinosila sala makowa bedewe bured ebowa waia Manna naiena tane mai inawinakasala donsapona, dia, uduudu bontontuwan.
Tane bured ne umanawa wadina ipa uboe iene wisena ita apana mida bured ema nadia ando mai bolepi, diaida.
Ne ipa bured inawinakasalala uboe iane winena, apana mida bured ema nadia me inawinakasala wadedie mampesade. Tane bured ema ipa ne etenaida itudi edina tawo inasapaa baiwa.”
Iuswa gagalo ema etane nuau kadileno muba wawadiadiantone waienase, “Ambi apana ema meba etepa nenepio nata?”
Iesu mo insakoau gagalowa etene baiwa diamone wanase, “Ne ulaipa dialedina, e mai Apana Otopa etepa ita me osinawa nana e bedelawo inaida dia.
Apana mida ne etena ita osinana nadia me inawinakasala wadedie mampesade, ita ne walama ompa osowe me inasapo bo bedewe enepiwisepi.
Ne ema epe wadina, ipawa ne etena ipa nanaida apana ina wanamode, ita ne osinana ipa esaida, mida nadia me inaida esawa wadedie mampesade.
Apana mida ne etena ita osinana nadia me ne bedenawo wankasaleide ita ne me bedewe wainedina.
Mamamba wankasalala ne waaubanen ita me wandia baiwa ne wainedina. Deawaa mida ne etena nadia ne wainedina baiwa me rua os wankasalepi.
Mapo e nosinosila bured Manna naie tane bontontuwan. Tane bured winakasala ema ipa uboe iene wisen ita apana mida bured ema nadia me wankasalepi, mai ando bolepi, dia.”
Iesu waeuwa ema gagalo duwe Kapeanaum bedewe wan.
Inawinakasala gagalowa
Iesu meba umanawa epe wano me warorowa etane nuau eino baiwa mo bedeuwo apana uara wane waienase, “Waeuwa ema badowaia, mida etaeta menasade?”
Mo dima momoduwantoia Iesu nuawe atenlene baiwa mo diamone wanase, “Ne aia ema wano e etale nuala surakausano baiwa eneana baiwaitilana, ba?
Ne uboe iane winena umanawa e dialeno etale nuala surakaulen. Tane Apana Otopa bauta wandiawo odepi alempo ewonuna walamawe dewa inainamba dainea segalepi e manlawo? E ne sumanainaitana, ba dia?
God Aleupa inaida apana wanamode, tane apanaida ete sauwa onapea mai inaida apana wanamopia rua, dia. Tane aia ne dialena mampe ne e Aleu kakaiwa ita inaida enaledina.
Tane e bedelawo isiwa mai sumanaintoipona, dia.” Iesu epe wana, ipawa me bumpeido atenlen mida me warorowa bedeuwo mai sumanaintoipona. Ita do atenlen mida ando me dabuasapie nanalepi.

Iesu osowesane wanase, “E bedelawo isiwa mai sumanaintoipona baiwa ne bauta dialene wanase, ‘Mai mida da me meba mukawe mainawo wimpia rua, dia. Tane me mida ne Mamana sausapie mukawa wanepio mainawo wimpi, mai mida da.’”
Gagalo ema aupe Iesu warorowa uara me wawe awa dabuantone eiena.
Mo ene antoiomawa Iesu wawe alala 12 me do sape eneia waitaramone wanase, “E do menaledia ne eneane aitana, ba?”
Saimon Pita Iesu sipoasane wanase, “Tatamba, e epe waiana no mida mampe antata? Inawinakasala aiawa e os manawo winede, no mai na ana rua, diaida!
No sumanaintene atenten e ipa kakaiwaida God mampea wien!”
Iesu Pita dima wana etene mo uduudu diamone wanase, “E wanawo alala uduudu 12 ne sonabalena, tane apana dea os e bedelawo kadi mamba Seitan bedewelene nolaleide!”
Aia ema Iesu Iudas Saimon Iskariot otopa umanawa wan. Me ipa Iesu wawe alala 12 bedeuwo mida ando Iesu dabuasapie laga mampe nanalepia.
